newsitem.title: USA: Sensormatic sees modest revs growth ahead.
newsitem.headline: Sensormatic sees modest revs growth ahead.

text.p: Sensormatic Electronics Corp, reporting a five percent rise in fiscal second-quarter revenues, said Wednesday it expected modest revenue growth for the rest of the fiscal year.

It said revenues from the commercial/industrial business fell eight percent in the second quarter. The business was hurt by product availability, especially in the CCTV product line, increased competition, and the rationalization of its European operations, it said.
President and Chief Executive Officer Bob Vanourek said, "Our cost-reduction efforts are beginning to pay off as we continue to improve systems and processes and lower our manufacturing costs.
"We expect continued modest overall revenue growth for the remainder of fiscal year 1997.

"Additionally, we have recently introduced several new products and expect to have further important new product releases by fiscal year-end. We believe our new products offer superior technology and are more cost competitive."
Sensormatic reported earnings for the second quarter, ended December 31, of $6.1 million or $0.08 per share, compared with a loss of $65.1 million or $0.88 per share a year earlier.
